inlines.v: IN'SOLENT, adjective Proud and haughty, with contempt of others; overbearing; domineering in power; as an insolent master. 1. Proceeding from insolence; haughty and contemptuous; as insolent words or behavior. 2. Unaccustomed; the primary sense. [Not used.]
